acronymble.followup: The old successful-PDF-only empty query did not cover HTML. A bounded pre-2016 HTML index and actual publisher navigation revealed the complete original main rules and six details pages. Current .com is parked, .co repurposed. The primary explicitly resolves Nymwit-writing/voting and bonuses, so conflicting secondary accounts were not substituted.

rave.followup: Actual public Fantazia 2008 page links eight 2007 original booklet scans. Initial transient image failures were retried in bounded requests and all eight succeeded. Hyperreal ordinary HTTP has a tiny cover image, not full rules; current Fantazia path is 404 and old author profile does not contain rules. Other missing component photographs are not recovered rulebook pages and are not required to accept the full core manual.

ddr-reise.evidence: New discovery supplies an explicitly German community gameplay description matching Klee 1989, five destinations, red-card relocation and return-to-start victory. It is a possible limited reference, not an inspected original manual. Exact initial-city selection and movement/arrival details remain to check; no acceptance or claim that all publisher/collector sources are exhausted. Different games Eine Harzreise and Drushba-Reise are not substituted.

alpha-nature.evidence: Primary BGG page describes matching 1992 Gary Wyatt / Green Board Game game. A French library PDF search lead is Alpha Animals, a related but differently themed game, and is not substituted. Earlier retailer source retrieval hold remains unresolved; no complete rulebook recovered in this pass.

calamity.evidence: Fresh exact Games Workshop 1983 searches found product/catalog descriptions, the Goblin entry explicitly without downloads, and related catalog/review leads. No newly retrieved complete manual. Talisman rules and Calamityville are different games.

deal-me-in.evidence: Exact Noraut 1988 identity was retained; Sackson prototype, poker software, modern rummy and similarly named retailers are excluded. A public seller listing says German rules are included, but no complete legible manual has been inspected or accepted.

ant-wars.evidence: The accessible Tabletopia rules are José C. R. (Jochewi) newer 2-6 player game, not Jason McAllister 1982 2-3 player game. They are not substituted. Older matching metadata lists an 8-page booklet but does not provide it.
